verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server that lets external agents like Claude or Cursor work with Klaviyo data and create campaigns. Separately, its in-product Composer AI can 'build the audience' from a stated goal. However, no evidence shows the MCP server or API creating a segment from a plain-language description, so the story is only partly supported. Missing for 10: documented segment-creation endpoint or MCP tool, evidence that an external agent can turn natural-language audience criteria into a saved segment, hands-on or independent corroboration.
